# Feature: Ice tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #1 (Ice tile) from Movement Tiles before it is used in real levels. Effect: slide until a wall stops you. Unique: you slide in your entry direction, the whole crossing in one input. Useful: forces planning around the braking wall, and crosses fast. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** slide until a wall stops you.

**So that** forces planning around the braking wall, and crosses fast.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Ice tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-1-ice-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: an orb halfway along an ice strip that ends at a wall. A player who slides straight in passes the orb and stops at the wall with no way back along the strip, so the restart teaches that the entry direction and the braking wall are the whole decision. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Step onto ice in a direction and you keep sliding that way within the same input until the next tile is a wall, lock or block
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: You cannot steer or stop midway, orbs on the line are collected, and the puzzle is choosing your entry direction against the braking wall

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Step onto ice in a direction and you keep sliding that way within the same input until the next tile is a wall, lock or block
- You cannot steer or stop midway, orbs on the line are collected, and the puzzle is choosing your entry direction against the braking wall
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Ice tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-1-ice-tile-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/movement-tiles.yml mechanic #1.
